title: Clavier-Übung III: Aus tiefer Not schrei ich zu dir (manualiter)
video_use_ideas: Severe four-voice texture for a setback or hard-times segment.
legal_notes: Composition PD worldwide (J. S. Bach d.1750). Mutopia piece 694 ('Aus tiefer Noth schrei' ich zu dir.', for Organ); licence shown as Public Domain on the piece page, in the Mutopia RDF and in the .ly header (placed in the public domain by typesetter Urs Metzger). Edition source: Bach-Album, Ernst H. Wolfram(editor), C. F. Peters, Leipzig. Preview is an own FluidSynth (FluidR3_GM) render of the Mutopia MIDI, not a human performance; no recording in this row.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
